config.name: api_key
config.description: Discourse Admin API key for full access

config.name: log_level
config.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error

config.name: tools_mode
config.description: Tool selection mode: auto, all, read, write, or search

config.name: allow_writes
config.description: Enable write operations like creating posts and topics (true/false)

config.name: user_api_key
config.description: Discourse User API key (alternative to admin API key)

config.name: max_read_length
config.description: Maximum character length for content reads

config.name: user_api_client_id
config.description: Client ID for User API key authentication

tools.name: discourse_select_site
tools.description: Validate and select a Discourse site for subsequent tool calls. Verifies the site is reachable and retrieves its title. Must be called before using other tools when multiple sites are configured.

params.name: site
params.description: Base URL of the Discourse site (e.g., 'https://meta.discourse.org' or 'https://community.example.com')

tools.name: discourse_search
tools.description: Search Discourse site content including topics, posts, and users. Use search operators like @username, #tag, category:name for filtered results.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query text (e.g., 'how to install plugin'). Supports Discourse search operators like @username, #tag, category:name, status:open, order:latest

params.name: max_results
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50). Default: 10

params.name: with_private
params.description: Include private messages and topics in search results (requires authentication). Default: false

tools.name: discourse_read_topic
tools.description: Read a Discourse topic including its metadata (title, category, tags) and posts. Supports pagination for long topics.

params.name: topic_id
params.description: The numeric ID of the topic to read (e.g., 12345 from URL /t/topic-slug/12345)

params.name: post_limit
params.description: Maximum number of posts to retrieve (1-100). Default: 5

params.name: start_post_number
params.description: Start reading from this post number (1-based). Use for pagination through long topics

tools.name: discourse_read_post
tools.description: Read a specific post by its ID. Returns the post content, author, creation date, and link to the post.

params.name: post_id
params.description: The numeric post ID to read (found in post JSON data or API responses)

tools.name: discourse_list_categories
tools.description: List all categories visible to the current user. Returns category names and topic counts. Useful for discovering where to post or search.

tools.name: discourse_list_tags
tools.description: List all available tags on the Discourse site (if tagging is enabled). Returns tag names and usage counts. Use tags in search queries with #tagname.

tools.name: discourse_get_user
tools.description: Get information about a Discourse user by username. Returns name, trust level, join date, bio, and profile link.

params.name: username
params.description: The Discourse username to look up (without @ symbol, e.g., 'codinghorror')

tools.name: discourse_list_user_posts
tools.description: Get a paginated list of posts and replies by a specific user, with the most recent first. Returns 30 posts per page. Includes topic title, post date, excerpt, and direct links.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination (0-based). Each page returns 30 posts. Default: 0

params.name: username
params.description: The Discourse username to fetch posts for (without @ symbol, e.g., 'codinghorror')

tools.name: discourse_filter_topics
tools.description: Filter topics with a concise query language: use key:value tokens separated by spaces; category/categories for categories (comma = OR, '=category' = without subcats, '-' prefix = exclude), tag/tags (comma = OR, '+' = AND) and tag_group; status:(open|closed|archived|listed|unlisted|public) and personal in:(bookmarked|watching|tracking|muted|pinned); dates: created/activity/latest-post-(before|after) with YYYY-MM-DD or N (days); numeric: likes[-op]-(min|max), posts-(min|max), posters-(min|max), vi

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (0-based, default: 0)

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter query, e.g. 'category:support status:open created-after:30 order:activity'

params.name: per_page
params.description: Items per page (max 50)

tools.name: discourse_list_chat_channels
tools.description: List all public chat channels visible to the current user. Returns channel information including title, description, and member counts. Supports filtering and pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of channels to return (default: 25, max: 100)

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter channels by name/slug

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset (default: 0)

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by channel status (e.g., 'open', 'closed', 'archived')

tools.name: discourse_list_user_chat_channels
tools.description: List all chat channels for the currently authenticated user, including both public channels they're a member of and direct message channels. Includes unread tracking information.

tools.name: discourse_get_chat_messages
tools.description: Get messages from a chat channel with flexible pagination and date-based filtering. Supports: (1) paginating with direction='past'/'future' from a target_message_id, (2) querying messages around a specific target_date, (3) getting messages around a target_message_id, or (4) fetching from last read position.

params.name: direction
params.description: Pagination direction: 'past' for older messages (DESC), 'future' for newer messages (ASC)

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of messages to return (default: 50, max: 500)

params.name: channel_id
params.description: The chat channel ID

params.name: target_date
params.description: ISO 8601 date string (e.g., '2024-01-15' or '2024-01-15T10:30:00Z') to query messages around that date

params.name: target_message_id
params.description: Message ID to query around or paginate from

params.name: fetch_from_last_read
params.description: If true, start from the user's last read message

params.name: include_target_message_id
params.description: Whether to include the target message in results (default: true)

tools.name: discourse_list_drafts
tools.description: List all drafts for the current user. Returns draft keys, sequences, and preview content. Use this to find existing drafts before updating them.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset (default: 0)

tools.name: discourse_get_draft
tools.description: Retrieve a specific draft by its key. Common keys: "new_topic" for new topic drafts, "topic_<id>" for reply drafts.

params.name: sequence
params.description: Expected sequence number (optional)

params.name: draft_key
params.description: Draft key (e.g., "new_topic", "topic_123", "new_private_message")

tools.name: search_discourse_communities
tools.description: Discover Discourse forum communities by topic or find similar communities. Use 'query' for semantic text search (e.g., 'note taking productivity') or 'similar_to' to find communities similar to a known one by URL or ID. Provide exactly one of 'query' or 'similar_to'. Returns communities with confidence scores and engagement metrics.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

params.name: query
params.description: Semantic text search query (e.g., 'note taking productivity')

params.name: locale
params.description: Filter by locale code (e.g., 'en', 'de', 'fr')

params.name: min_users
params.description: Filter by minimum total user count

params.name: similar_to
params.description: Find communities similar to this one. Accepts a community URL (e.g., 'https://forum.obsidian.md') or ID (e.g., 'discover_1376')

params.name: engagement_tier
params.description: Filter by engagement level: high (>5% MAU), medium (>1% MAU), low (<1% MAU)

prompts.name: discourse-search-help
prompts.description: Generate an optimized search query for Discourse using search operators

prompts.name: discourse-post-draft
prompts.description: Help draft a well-structured Discourse post or reply

prompts.name: discourse-summarize-topic
prompts.description: Generate a summary of a Discourse topic discussion

prompts.name: discourse-reply-suggestions
prompts.description: Generate thoughtful reply suggestions for a Discourse topic

resources.name: site-info
resources.description: Current Discourse site configuration and connection status
